prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters, simple rounded people with big round eyes, small dot pupils and overbites, flat colour and black outlines everywhere except the faces, which are rendered with startling real skin: pores, stubble, sweat, tired wet eyes. Every flat colour is laid on with thick visible oil brushstrokes. Only the bodies, clothes and places are cartoon: every face in the frame, however small, is painted as real human skin with wrinkles, pores, bags under the eyes and real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, and no feature is exaggerated. Seen from inside a dark 1930s speakeasy doorway, looking out through the open sliding slot of a heavy steel door: the slot is a bright letterbox of light in the black, and filling it, leaning close to whisper, the face of a gangster in his forties with a flattened nose, a scar through one eyebrow, heavy stubble and a grey fedora brim, his eyes shifting left and right. Wide areas of plain dark door around the slot. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
